# Arcora

> Arcora is a secure life admin dashboard for organizing household records, bills, subscriptions, warranties, documents, passwords, reminders, deadlines, and important dates.

Arcora is a web application for private household admin and personal record organization. Production builds generate this file with absolute URLs from `VITE_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`.

## Product Summary

- Product category: secure life admin dashboard.
- Primary use: organize household records and deadlines in one account-based workspace.
- Core modules: bills, subscriptions, warranties, documents, passwords, reminders, and dashboard review.
- Access: public pages invite users to start a free account. Arcora does not publish paid pricing or plan-limit details on these public pages.
- Support contact: app.arcora@gmail.com.

## Main Public Pages

- [Arcora homepage](/): Secure life admin dashboard for household records, bills, subscriptions, warranties, documents, passwords, reminders, and important dates.
- [Bill reminder app](/bill-reminder-app): Feature page for tracking household bill due dates, recurring payments, payment notes, reminders, and supporting documents.
- [Subscription tracker](/subscription-tracker): Feature page for tracking active subscriptions, renewal dates, recurring charges, cancellation notes, and related records.
- [Warranty tracker](/warranty-tracker): Feature page for organizing product details, purchase records, warranty expiration dates, receipts, and coverage reminders.
- [Personal document organizer](/personal-document-organizer): Feature page for organizing household documents, statements, receipts, warranty files, detected dates, notes, and reminders.
- [Important date reminder app](/important-date-reminder-app): Feature page for reminders tied to bills, renewals, warranties, document dates, and household deadlines.
- [Password organizer](/password-organizer): Feature page for organizing household account records, encrypted saved password values, recovery files, linked websites, and review notes.
- [Household management app](/household-management-app): Feature page for the broader household admin system across bills, subscriptions, warranties, documents, passwords, and reminders.

## Trust, Support, and Legal Pages

- [Security overview](/security): Explains account access, user-scoped records, document storage, password handling, data ownership, deletion and export support, and contact paths.
- [About Arcora](/about): Explains what Arcora is, why it exists, and how it helps organize private life admin records.
- [Contact Arcora](/contact): Support page for account help, privacy requests, deletion requests, bug reports, complaints, and product questions.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Explains what Arcora stores, how information is used, storage providers, documents, password records, deletion requests, and privacy contact.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Explains user responsibilities, content ownership, sensitive records, responsible use, availability, deletion support, and contact.

## Structured Data Notes

- Public marketing pages include Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, and visible FAQPage schema where FAQ content is shown on the page.
- Arcora does not publish ratings, reviews, awards, customer counts, or paid pricing claims in structured data.
- Production canonical, sitemap, robots, and llms.txt URLs are controlled by `VITE_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`.
